title: Local interpretation evidence for ENSO climate signals
question: How should ENSO signals be interpreted for specific sectors and places?
why_it_matters: ENSO outlooks are official climate signals, but local implications depend on teleconnections, basin conditions, crop regions, hazard exposure, and sector-specific interpretation.
current_support: FTFN has NOAA CPC ENSO as an official source and an in-review ENSO signal.
next_action: Add regional climate and sector-specific sources before local ENSO conclusions.
notes: Medium priority until a target sector or place is selected.
